title: Space Pouch
description: A private room in the dimension of Emptiness.
body:
**Space Pouch** - Create your own personal room in the Abyss dimension!

**Features:**

* Right-click to teleport.
  
* Teleportation will cancel if you move or take damage.
  
* Each bundle contains a unique room that cannot be entered without the bundle.
  
* The room will be destroyed if you lose the original bundle.
  
* You can create a copy of the bundle and link it to the original to grant access to the room to another player.

**All crafts in Gallery**

**Requires: Fabric API | Minecraft: 1.20.1**

**The mod is in early development and will be updated gradually.**
